, Reason for Mistake: Chose an inappropriate method to answer the question by using an ImageNet classification model (EfficientNetB0) and counting “bird” labels from top-5 predictions as distinct species. Image classification returns alternative class guesses for the whole frame, not multiple concurrent objects, so it cannot count simultaneous species. It also lacks species-level coverage and relies on a flawed “label contains ‘bird’” heuristic. This methodological error prevents obtaining the correct maximum (3) and is directly responsible for the wrong/absent final answer.
